description: Natural light fills this welcoming Kensington home, with big picture windows and skylights brightening both levels. Settle into the large, cozy living room, gathered around a gas fireplace beneath vaulted ceilings. From there, the vaulted dining room flows into a kitchen made for everyday living, with bar seating, a built-in desk, a pantry and all appliances included. The main floor primary suite makes one-level living easy, with a walk-in closet and private 3/4 bath with walk-in shower. A powder room and laundry complete the level, and extra wide doorways and a backyard access ramp add comfort and convenience. Upstairs, a skylit family room connects two bedrooms and a full bath, with new carpet throughout. One bedroom has its own walk-in closet and is plumbed for a future gas fireplace. Central A/C and gas forced air keep you comfortable in every season, the HOA cares for the front yard, and the rear 2-car garage is tucked off the alley. Rainier Vista Community Park, with its sports fields, pickleball courts and paved walking paths, is less than a mile away.
